# `foxglove projects members`

[Command reference](README.md) · [Parent command](projects.md)

```text
Add or remove project members

Usage: foxglove projects members [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  add     Give organization members access to a project
  remove  Remove organization members' access to a project
  help    Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --client-id <CLIENT_ID>
          Foxglove client ID

      --config <CONFIG>
          Config file

      --debug[=<DEBUG>]
          Print debug diagnostics, including HTTP requests, to stderr

          [default: false]

  -h, --help
          Print help
```
